_readme: Owner-curated series cast: cast_builder restores these names/looks VERBATIM per chapter
instead of re-guessing (it once gave Dokja and Michio the same look, Ep128).
Write looks POSITIVELY (list every outfit the character wears in the arcs being
processed); exclusions go in `not` — 'no glasses' in the text would count AS glasses.
Entries absent from a chapter are never injected. Seed a draft from existing chapters:

cast.visual_description: A young man with short dark hair, wearing a long white coat or a light grey suit jacket over a black shirt.
A young man with dark hair and glasses, wearing a black button-down shirt over a white t-shirt and a dark jacket.
